arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of Growth and Decay at the Tree of Whispers.

Dealing damage to an enemy afflicts them with {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} that deals {c_random}{SF_13}{/c} Shadow damage the next time damage is dealt. Afterwards, {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} will jump to another enemy up to a maximum of {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} times.{if:SF_2}

After bouncing onto {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} enemies, the hex bounces back to you granting {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Fortify and removing all crowd control and negative status effects.{/if} {c_important}Hex of Whispers{/c} may only be applied once every {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} seconds.
After bouncing onto {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} enemies, the hex bounces back to you granting {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Fortify and removing all crowd control and negative status effects.
